name: commit

frames.best_why: The full commit card is open with every file row and its green and red line counts visible.

tagline: Commit summary that folds open into a per-file changed-lines list.
summary: A compact commit card with avatar, message, short hash, author and relative time, plus a copy button; clicking the header reveals each changed file with an A/M/D/R status and green or red line counts.
appearance: A dark rounded card. The top row pairs a round MC avatar with a bold message line and a smaller line holding a commit glyph, short hash, author and time, with a copy icon at the right. Below a divider, five file rows each show a coloured status letter, file icon, monospace path and green plus or red minus counts.
behaviour: The header acts as a button that collapses or expands the file list, dimming slightly on hover. Rows tint under the pointer, and the copy icon swaps to a tick for a moment after the hash is copied.
demo_content: Message feat(auth): rotate refresh tokens on every request; author Maya Chen; five files across src and docs.
use_when: A changelog, agent transcript or activity feed needs to show one code change with its files and line totals.
avoid_when: Full diff review: it lists file names and totals only, with no patch content to inspect.
customise: Assemble the card from exported parts: header, avatar initials, message, hash, timestamp, copy button and per-file rows; most inner pieces accept class names and standard element props.
weight_why: A collapsible list of five rows and a clipboard call; no animation loop.

a11y.note: The header toggles from the keyboard, but the icon-only copy button and the single-letter file statuses lack text labels.

issues: The copy control and the one-letter file statuses carry no text labels for assistive tech.
polish_why: Neat, legible commit card with restrained colour; small status letters and icon-only copy are minor.
title: Commit
